an5.23:1.1: pañcime bhikkhave jātarūpassa upakkilesā, yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhaṃ jātarūpaṃ na ceva mudu hoti, na ca kammaniyaṃ, na ca pabhassaraṃ, pabhaṅgu ca, na ca sammā upeti kammāya.
an5.23:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave pañca jātarūpassa upakkilesā, yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhaṃ jātarūpaṃ na ceva mudu hoti, na ca kammaniyaṃ na ca pabhassaraṃ, pabhaṅgu ca, na ca sammā upeti kammāya.
an5.23:1.5: yato ca kho bhikkhave jātarūpaṃ imehi pañcahi upakkilesehi vippamuttaṃ hoti, taṃ hoti jātarūpaṃ mudu ca kammaniyañca pabhassaraṃ ca, na ca pabhaṅgu, sammā upeti kammāya
an5.23:1.6: yassā yassā ca pilandhanavikatiyā ākaṅkhati: yadi muddikāya yadi kuṇḍalāya yadi gīveyyakāya yadi suvaṇṇamālakāya. tañcassa atthaṃ anuhoti.
an5.23:2.1: evameva kho bhikkhave pañcime cittassa upakkilesā yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhaṃ cittaṃ naceva mudu hoti, na ca kammaniyaṃ. na ca pabhassaraṃ, pabhaṅgu ca, na ca sammāsamādhīyati āsavānaṃ khayāya.
an5.23:2.4: ime kho bhikkhave pañca cittassa upakkilesā yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhaṃ cittaṃ na ceva mudu hoti, na ca kammaniyaṃ, na ca pabhassaraṃ. pabhaṅgu ca, na ca sammāsamādhīyati āsavānaṃ khayāya.
an5.23:2.5: yato ca kho bhikkhave cittaṃ imehi pañcahi upakkilesehi vippamuttaṃ hoti, taṃ hoti cittaṃ mudu ca kammaniyañca pabhassarañca, na ca pabhaṅgu, sammāsamādhīyati āsavānaṃ khayāya.
an5.23:2.6: yassa yassa ca abhiññāsacchikaraṇīyassa dhammassa cittaṃ abhininnāmeti abhiññā sacchikiriyāya, tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
an5.23:3.1: so sace ākaṅkhati: “anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhaveyyaṃ, ekopi hutvā bahudhā assaṃ …pe… yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteyyanti”
an5.23:3.2: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
an5.23:4.1: so sace ākaṅkhati: “dibbāya sotadhātuyā visuddhāya atikkantamānusikāya ubho sadde suṇeyyaṃ dibbe ca mānuse ca ye dūre ye santike cā”ti.
an5.23:4.2: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
an5.23:5.1: so sace ākaṅkhati “parasattānaṃ parapuggalānaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajāneyyaṃ
an5.23:5.16: vimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ,
an5.23:5.17: avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ avimuttaṃ cittanti pajāneyya”nti.
an5.23:5.18: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
an5.23:6.1: so sace ākaṅkhati “anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussareyyaṃ - seyyathīdaṃ: ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo …pe… iti sākāraṃ sa uddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussareyya”nti,
an5.23:6.2: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
an5.23:7.1: so sace ākaṅkhati “dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena …pe… yathākammūpage satte pajāneyya”nti
an5.23:7.2: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
an5.23:8.1: so sace ākaṅkhati “āsavānaṃ khayā (anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ) …pe… sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyya”nti,
an5.23:8.2: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyataneti.
